name: kaki-rally
description: A standalone Kaki racing game with rally, drift, stock, deformable dunes, track drawing, Monster Smash, and Trials.

scripts.test: npm run test:renderer && npm run test:racing && npm run test:standalone && npm run test:assets && npm run test:raid
scripts.test:racing: node tools/smoke-rally-availability.mjs && node tools/smoke-drift-stock-expansion.mjs && node tools/smoke-rally-raid-expansion.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-cameras.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-physics.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-tracks.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-draw-track.mjs && node tools/smoke-dune-draw-track.mjs && node tools/smoke-rally-grass.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-monster.mjs && node tools/smoke-monster-arena.mjs && node tools/smoke-monster-vehicle-physics.mjs && node tools/smoke-monster-records.mjs && node tools/smoke-dune-heightfield.mjs && node tools/smoke-dune-deformation.mjs && node tools/smoke-dune-vehicle-physics.mjs && node tools/smoke-dune-records.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-trials.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-visuals.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-lifecycle.mjs
scripts.test:standalone: node tools/smoke-rally-save.mjs && node tools/smoke-standalone-boundaries.mjs && node tools/smoke-catastrophe-isolation.mjs && node tools/smoke-standalone-lifecycle.mjs
scripts.test:raid: node tools/smoke-raid-isolation.mjs && node tools/generate-raid-frozen-boundaries.mjs --check && node tools/smoke-raid-surface-field.mjs && node tools/smoke-raid-route.mjs && node tools/smoke-raid-sector-seams.mjs && node tools/smoke-raid-jumps.mjs && node tools/smoke-raid-terrain-provider.mjs
